content.text:
I've submitted index 1 (Sb fraction 0.227) as the best composition, but I didn't find a real photoactive composition. None of the five EQE measurements showed a photoresponse clearly above zero.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.227 | 0.00011 |
| 7 | 0.386 | 0.00002 |
| 11 | 0.517 | −0.00312 |
| 15 | 0.654 (CuSb₂O₆ region) | −0.00016 |
| 23 | 0.852 | −0.00033 |

- **Why index 1:** it had the only clearly positive reading, and the copper-rich end is the most plausible place for activity. Phase mixtures containing CuO there should absorb the 2.1 eV light.
- **How the budget went:** I spread the first four measurements across the line, and they all came back near zero. I spent the last one on index 11, the largest unsampled gap and the model's top suggestion. It gave the lowest (negative) value on the line.
- **Not measured:** the other 25 compositions, including indices 0, 2–6 and 24–29 at the two ends. A narrow active peak there could have been missed.
- **XRD unused:** I spent none of the 5 XRD measurements, so I have no phase evidence behind any of these readings.
